item.title: Public urged to be vigilant over online ads during festive period – CERT
item.description: The Sri Lanka Computer Emergency Readiness Team (SL CERT) has issued a public advisory urging people to exercise caution when engaging with online advertisements as the festive season approaches. MORE..

item.title: Netanyahu threatens Iran new leader, says government collapse uncertain
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Thursday issued a veiled threat to kill Iran s new supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei even as he acknowledged that Israel s joint air war with the U.S. may not lead to a collapse of Tehran s clerical government. MORE..

item.title: Watch what happens - Trump issues new threat to Iran
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump issued a new threat online to Iran, writing- “Watch what happens to these deranged scumbags today.” MORE..

item.title: Compensation process begins for farmers affected by crop damage in 2025'26 Maha Season
item.description: The Agricultural and Agrarian Insurance Board has announced that damage assessment activities have already commenced in the relevant districts for the release of compensation to farmers affected by crop damage during the 2025'2026 Maha season . MORE..

item.title: Corruption probe against Shasheendra Rajapaksa concluded- Bribery Comm. informs court
item.description: The Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) informed the Colombo Magistrate s Court today that investigations into former State Minister Shasheendra Rajapaksa and other suspects, who are currently out on bail in connection with a corruption allegation, have been concluded. MORE..

item.title: Sri Lanka s largest groundwater source discovered in Pitabeddara
item.description: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) says it has discovered the largest groundwater source in Sri Lanka thus far during tube well drilling carried out near the Pitabeddara Police Station. MORE..

item.title: 84 Iranian sailors remains to be repatriated on special flight today – Defence Ministry
item.description: The bodies of 84 Iranian sailors killed in the torpedo attack on the warship IRIS Dena off Sri Lanka s coast are scheduled to be repatriated to Iran today on a special flight departing from Mattala International Airport, the Defence Ministry said. MORE..

item.title: Low-floor buses for persons with disabilities to be deployed before Sinhala and Tamil New Year
item.description: Additional Secretary to the President (Clean Sri Lanka Programme), Engineer S.P.C. Sugeeshwara, stated that plans are underway to deploy the low-floor buses, imported for the benefit of persons with disabilities, ahead of the upcoming Sinhala and Tamil New Year. MORE..

item.title: Advisory issued for severe lightning
item.description: An Amber advisory has been issued by the Department of Meteorology for severe lightning in the Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and Galle and Matara districts. MORE..

item.title: Easter attacks case against Hemasiri and Pujith taken up in court
item.description: The Colombo Special High Court Trial-at-Bar has ordered to present defence evidence on March 26 related to the case filed against former Defence Secretary Hemasiri Fernando and former Inspector General of Police Pujith Jayasundara. MORE..
